verdict.rationale: Datalab documents an official Python SDK covering document conversion, pipelines, structured extraction, form filling, and file management, with dedicated SDK doc pages and a companion CLI, so the core of building against an official SDK is delivered. missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs in languages beyond Python, independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK's quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Datalab Python SDK provides a simple interface for document conversion, pipelines, structured extraction, form filling, and file management.
The SDK provides a simple interface to convert documents to Markdown, HTML, JSON, or chunks.
Fill PDF and image forms with structured field data using the Datalab SDK.
